arStrings.szText: "Astaroth told me he planted his blood across Sanctuary."
I remember those days. Sunless, ashen days. Back then, I...I had just lost my sister, you see. Braega. She had a voice like sparrowsong and a wit sharp as a dagger.
And a husband like a stubborn goat. Donan was her man. That’s how I knew him. Sorry I didn’t fess up sooner.
We three were close, once. But I...distanced myself when I couldn’t dissuade him from sticking Astaroth under his keep.
(sighs) But they’re dead, and what’s done is done. Only one way forwards. Hone your strength, and I’ll keep working on the blood.
